annotations.title: Add addresses to my unsubscribe list

description: Add your own addresses to your unsubscribe list (stored as keyed hashes). keep_address true also keeps them sealed so suppression_export gives them back. At most 50,000 per list.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

keep_address.description: Also keep the address sealed for export (default false: hash only).

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.
